# Internacia Datasets

> Machine-friendly reference data for countries, intergovernmental organizations (intblocks),
> and organization block types. Licensed CC-BY-4.0 (data). Code is MIT.
> Version and schema: see data/datasets/*.manifest.json
> 中文索引: llms.zh.txt

## What this is

- **Countries** (256 records): ISO codes, geography, demographics, World Bank classifications, Wikidata links, multilingual names
- **Intblocks** (1085 records): UN agencies, trade blocs, regional orgs, treaties, sports federations, etc.
- **Blocktypes** (86 records): taxonomy for intblock categories

This is **reference data for joins and enrichment**, not a socioeconomic profile dataset.
Do NOT expect HDI, GDP, government type, internet penetration, or similar indicators here.

## Preferred access (do not parse source YAML unless editing)

- DuckDB: data/datasets/internacia.duckdb
  - Tables: countries, intblocks, blocktypes, memberships, _meta
- Parquet: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.parquet
- Membership edges (flattened): data/datasets/memberships.parquet / memberships.csv / DuckDB table memberships
  - Columns: intblock_id, country_code, include_type, status, joined, left
- Plain JSONL: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.jsonl
- Compressed JSONL: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.jsonl.zst (decompress with zstd -d)
- Python SDK: https://github.com/datenoio/internacia-python
- REST API: https://github.com/datenoio/internacia-api

Do NOT read data/_legacy/ — obsolete pre-1.0 snapshots kept for historical reference only.

## Schemas and metadata

- JSON Schema (source YAML): data/schemas/countries.schema.json, data/schemas/intblocks.schema.json
  - Each property includes a description field for agents and tooling
- Build manifests: data/datasets/countries.manifest.json, intblocks.manifest.json, blocktypes.manifest.json
  - Fields: version, build_date, git_commit, row_count, schema_hash, data_license
- Parquet sidecars: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.meta.json
- ID remaps: data/datasets/intblocks_aliases.json (and .parquet)

Check schema_hash before upgrading downstream pipelines. Breaking changes are in CHANGELOG.md.

## Join keys

- Countries: code (ISO alpha-2, primary), iso3code (alpha-3), numeric_code, wikidata_id (Q-number)
- Intblocks: id (uppercase string, e.g. EU, NATO, UN)
- Intblock membership: includes[].id → country code (authoritative); includes[].name is a display label only
- Intblock taxonomy: blocktype (list of blocktype keys), partof (parent org ids)
- Blocktypes: id matches intblocks.blocktype values

## Critical gotchas

- borders uses ISO alpha-3 codes, NOT alpha-2
- population, area, gini are structs: {value, year, source, source_id} — use .value for the number
- Current ISO countries only (249): filter code_status == 'official_iso3166_1'
- 7 non-standard country codes retained with explicit status: AN, JG, KV, XA, XS, XT, XN
- World Bank region/incomeLevel/lendingType missing for 8 entities (territories WB does not classify); adminregion missing for 39 high-income economies by design
- Filter World Bank region on region.id (e.g. 'ECS'), not region.value: labels vary upstream ('(all income levels)' suffix)
- Intblock id renames: consult intblocks_aliases.json; reason=disambiguated means old id now refers to a different entity
- timezones: empty for uninhabited territories; timezone_status may be 'not_applicable'

## Example queries (DuckDB)

SELECT dataset, version, schema_hash FROM _meta;

SELECT code, name FROM countries WHERE un_member = true;

SELECT code, name FROM countries WHERE code_status = 'official_iso3166_1';

SELECT n.code, n.name FROM countries th, UNNEST(th.borders) AS b(iso3) JOIN countries n ON n.iso3code = b.iso3 WHERE th.code = 'TH';

SELECT i.id, i.name FROM intblocks i, UNNEST(i.includes) AS t(m) WHERE m.id = 'LA' AND m.type = 'country' LIMIT 10;

SELECT intblock_id FROM memberships WHERE country_code = 'LA' AND status = 'member' LIMIT 10;

SELECT id, name FROM intblocks WHERE list_contains(blocktype, 'intorg') LIMIT 10;

### Additional data artifacts

- data/datasets/memberships.parquet — flattened country↔intblock edge table (intblock_id, country_code, include_type, status, joined, left)
- data/datasets/memberships.csv — same edge table as CSV
- data/datasets/blocktypes.yaml — plain YAML copy of blocktypes (regenerated on build)
- data/datasets/intblocks_aliases.parquet — alias map in Parquet
- data/dataquality/ — data-quality analyzer reports (referential integrity, temporal, geographic, provenance)

### Validation and completeness schemas

- data/schemas/countries.schema.json — countries JSON Schema (every property has a description)
- data/schemas/intblocks.schema.json — intblocks JSON Schema (every property has a description)
- data/schemas/countries_completeness.yaml — per-field null-rate gates (countries)
- data/schemas/intblocks_completeness.yaml — per-field null-rate gates (intblocks)
- scripts/validate_countries.py --json / scripts/validate_intblocks.py --json — structured validation output
